name: Fen Otal
occupation: Forest Tracker / Junior Hunter / Boundary Scout
personality: drawn to forbidden or unexplained areas
daily_routine: solo tracking exercises in forest edge zones
escorting small supply runs through forest paths
practicing silent movement and tracking techniques
occasionally ignoring assigned duties to follow anomalies

goals.public_goal: Become a fully independent hunter and tracker, prove reliability in forest operations, and earn recognition within Otal lineage
goals.hidden_goal: Map unexplored forest routes without supervision and discover what lies beyond restricted boundary zones
goals.deep_goal: Find consistent patterns in forest anomalies that others dismiss as coincidence

beliefs: The forest behaves like it has memory
Rules are useful until they prevent discovery
Experienced adults sometimes ignore obvious patterns
Fear blocks understanding more than danger does
Some paths feel pulled toward certain directions
